# Menubar

A row of menus, as in desktop apps.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Menubar is for dense desktop tools and not phones. Visitors come from social posts on their phones, and the site sections use navigation menu. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./navigation-menu">Navigation menu</a>, <a href="./drawer">Drawer</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A dense desktop-style tool with many commands grouped by menu.
- **Not when:** Website navigation (navigation menu), or phones.

Instead:

- [Navigation menu](./navigation-menu.md): Site navigation, not commands.
- [Dropdown menu](./dropdown-menu.md): One menu from one button.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between and within menus; Escape closes. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add menubar
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

From shadcn/ui. It reads shadcn's variables, which theme.css maps onto this system's semantic tokens, and the radius, shadow and text scale in shadcn.css.
